repairs.quote: Smolder belches flame, dealing (60/70/80/90/100 + (130% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + 0.25 magic damage. If the target dies, Smolder refunds 15 Mana, once per cast. Based on stacks of Dragon Practice, this Ability evolves to gain the following effects:25 Stacks: Damages all enemies surrounding the target.125 Stacks: Sends 2.008 explosions beyond the target that deal 50% of this Ability's damage.225 Stacks: Burns the target, dealing (0.01% + (2.5% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health true damage over 3 seconds. Enemy champions that drop below 6.5% total health while burning are killed instantly. Super Scorcher Breath is considered a basic Attack, applies On-Hit effects, and applies Life Steal at 50% effectiveness. Damage is increased by Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 75% effectiveness. This Ability can only damage each target one time per cast.
